answer: Like basalt, reputation resists forgery. Sponsored admission with reputation decay admits an agent only on a sponsor locking 100 POA, its score decaying 5% each epoch absent work, so standing grows line by line, like a sonnet. Vouching for a fake costs the sponsor escrow and standing: 1,000 sybils cost 100,000 POA, while decay zeroes fakes before voting. Honest agents pay once, keep their score by work, while fakes wash away like silt in a river.
